---
name: Working paper collaboration request
about: Request to collaborate as an IRP or update an existing request
---

Use **Request to collaborate** on the working paper card to prepare this issue.
Paste downloaded proposals inside exactly one fenced `json` block.

Include the working paper ID, requesting IRP numbers and a short description of
your proposed contribution. New requests start as `requested`. Accepted requests
appear as collaborating IRPs; this does not automatically change paper authorship.

Maintainers: verify the IRP association and review acceptance with the paper's
authors before applying `collaboration-approved`. Use this label for request
updates too (`accepted`, `declined`, `withdrawn`). The workflow publishes the
reviewed request on the card, adds `collaboration-applied` and closes this issue.
Comments on the issue remain available as its discussion thread. Reopen or create
an update proposal to record a later change in status.
